hooks.command: printf '%s' "$TOOL_OUTPUT" | grep -qiE '(error|exception|traceback|segfault|SIGABRT|panic|fatal|FAILED|Error:)' && echo '[tot-mcp] Detected a failure pattern. Consider using /tot-reason to systematically investigate with Tree of Thought reasoning.' || true

CLI="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA}/build/packages/server/dist/cli.js"; [ -f "$CLI" ] && node "$CLI" status 2>/dev/null | grep -q '^\s*\[\*\]' && echo '[tot-mcp] Active reasoning session detected. Use /tot-inspect to view or /tot-reason to continue.' || true
